name: RecordTable
title: Templates/Platform/Detail/RecordTable
summary: A DNS zone detail page, opened from its index: a full-bleed tab bar with Main settings and Records over a scrolling tab panel. Main settings is a settings form in the form column: four stacked sections (General, Configure your nameserver, DNSSEC, Status), each an anchored heading with a hint glyph over a flush `Card` of `ItemList` rows. Name and Domain Name are required `Input`s that show a required `HelperText` only after a failed save; the three nameservers and, while DNSSEC is on, the key tag, algorithm, digest type and digest are read-only code `Input`s in an `InputGroupRoot` with a transparent `CopyButton`; DNSSEC and Active are `Switch`es; editing anything raises the save bar at the bottom. Records is a small-heading list inside the tab (Documentation and Add Record actions) with the TableView controls row (Type and Policy filters) and a records table: the value cell pins a copy button, Weight and Description fall back to an em dash, and the row menu carries Edit and Delete. Built from `PageHeader`, `PageTabs`, `SettingsSection`, `SettingRow`, `SaveBar`, `Tabs`, `Card`, `ItemList`, `Input`, `InputGroupRoot`, `CopyButton`, `Switch`, `HelperText`, `Button` and the TableView controls row and table recipes.
